classification.difficultyReason: Use the supplied right-triangle diagram to identify opposite and adjacent sides, select tangent, rearrange for the horizontal distance and round.

content.prompt: A boat out at sea observes a house on top of a $120\text{ m}$ cliff at an angle of elevation of $5^\circ$. How far out to sea is the boat? Give your answer to 1 decimal place.

spec.description: Source schematic with observation point left, horizontal sea level, vertical cliff right and rising line of sight. The contextual water texture is replaced by an unshaded horizontal line. The schematic is not drawn to scale.
spec.mathematics: The vertical cliff is labelled 120 m, the angle at the boat is labelled 5 degrees and the cliff foot has a right-angle marker. No distance answer is shown.

answer.worked:
Let $d$ be the horizontal distance from the boat to the foot of the cliff, in metres.
$$\begin{align*}\tan5^\circ&=\frac{120}{d}\\d\tan5^\circ&=120\\d&=\frac{120}{\tan5^\circ}\\d&\approx1371.6\end{align*}$$
The boat is $1371.6\text{ m}$ out to sea.
